performance.verdict: CPL efficiency is real, but zero pipeline conversion exposes an intake failure, not an ads win.

findings.text: 3 overdue SOW milestones (phone-match attribution 8/7, sync/contact cleanup 8/14, renewal accountability 7/23) remain undelivered during the prove-it month.
CPL fell 38.43% as spend dropped 40.42% with only a 3.23% lead dip — efficiency gain is real but driven by budget pacing, not audience improvement; $11.46 CPL at $35.95/day spend rate is thin volume.

3-day signal (8/16–8/18): leads 3+8+5=16 vs prior 3 days (8/13–8/15): 4+1+1=6 — a sharp recovery after the 8/14–8/15 trough, but spend also recovered (41+35+29 vs 42+19+19), so CPL held roughly flat at ~$10.

GHL shows 125 leads and 84 opportunities created in 28 days but 0 appointments logged and 0 won — 41 leads never became opps; pipeline is structurally broken or unmeasured, making the client's scoreboard unreadable.
GBP actions fell 32.08% week-over-week and hit 0 on 8/17–8/18; search clicks dropped 66.67% — organic floor is eroding while paid carries all visible traffic.

suggestions.text: Audit GHL pipeline immediately: trace why 0 appointments logged against 84 opportunities; fix intake or tagging within 5 days.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 84 opportunities created and 125 leads received in 28 days, but 0 appointments are logged — the client's core scoreboard (leads → scheduled → showed → patient) is completely dark. Ahmed/Ali must audit the appointment stage: confirm whether Flex Dental or OpenDental is recording bookings outside GHL, and whether the GHL pipeline stages are mapped to capture them. Success is defined as at least the last 14 days of appointments visible in GHL by 2026-08-22, which is also when the sync/contact cleanup milestone (overdue since 8/14) must be confirmed closed.

suggestions.text: Close phone-match attribution gap (overdue 8/7): confirm call tracking numbers routing correctly so inbound calls map to lead source.
suggestions.monday_update: The phone-match attribution milestone was due 8/7 and has no confirmed completion event. With 58 GBP calls in 28 days and GHL tracking numbers in place, unmatched calls represent a direct blind spot in the client's scoreboard. The attribution team must verify GHL tracking number call forwarding is live and logging, and confirm source attribution is writing correctly on inbound call contacts. Success check: at least the past 7 days of inbound calls visible with source in GHL by 2026-08-22.

suggestions.text: Watch Meta spend recovery: if 3-day CPL stays ≤$12 through 8/21, consider a modest +15% daily budget increase then.
suggestions.monday_update: The 3-day lead recovery (16 leads, 8/16–8/18 vs 6 leads, 8/13–8/15) at roughly $10 CPL is encouraging, but daily spend is only $35.95 — well below the prior run rate of ~$65/day seen in late July. Before scaling, the intake pipeline (F4) must be visible and working, or additional leads will disappear without evidence. Re-check on 2026-08-22: if CPL holds at or below $12 and GHL appointments are logging, raise daily budget by +15% as a first step.
